quarterly_data.quarter: AstraZeneca press release: AstraZeneca completes global license agreement for oral (09-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Zegfrovy (sunvozertinib) clinical and guideline status stated in the licence-completion release: it is included in the NCCN Clinical Practice Guidelines for NSCLC as a recommended subsequent therapy option for EGFR exon 20 insertion mutation-positive advanced or metastatic NSCLC, and the global WU-KONG28 Phase III trial supporting the 1st-line filings was presented as a Late-Breaking Abstract Oral Presentation at the 2026 ASCO Annual Meeting and simultaneously published in The New England Journal of Medicine. The company cites a real-world five-year overall survival rate as low as 8% for patients with EGFR exon 20 insertion NSCLC.
quarterly_data.figure: NCCN-recommended subsequent therapy; WU-KONG28 published in NEJM; real-world five-year OS as low as 8%
